title: CBW Affiliate Campaign and Offer Model V1
auditCorrection: Owner Audit Correction 026 (finding A): operational field names are now neutral (no *Placeholder suffix) so runtime records can hold actual observed PUBLIC affiliate URLs, codes, redirect hops and visible offer values as evidence. Example VALUES remain fake and use example.invalid. Secrets, tokens, cookies, private dashboard data and personal data are excluded and never committed to Git.
description: Models affiliate campaigns, links, redirect observations, offers and public verification levels for continuous monitoring of the real owner-approved campaign.

dataClassificationRules.PUBLIC_OBSERVED: Public landing URLs, public referral codes and visible offer values that anyone can observe without logging in. Allowed as evidence.
dataClassificationRules.INTERNAL_COMMERCIAL: Owner commercial terms not publicly visible; stored governed, not on public pages.
dataClassificationRules.SENSITIVE_SECRET: Private affiliate-dashboard links, credentials, cookies and access tokens. MUST NEVER be committed to Git and MUST NOT be collected by monitoring.
dataClassificationRules.PERSONAL_DATA: Any personal account data. MUST NOT be collected in L0-L3.

fields.campaignIdentifier: public campaign id as observed, e.g. EXAMPLECAMPAIGN (fake example)

invariants: affiliate route and referral-code changes are owner-gated; ownerApprovedRoute defaults false

fields.sourceAffiliateUrl: the public affiliate URL as observed, e.g. https://go.example.invalid/binance-kz-example (real observed public URLs allowed at runtime)
fields.referralCode: the public referral code as observed, e.g. EXAMPLECODE (fake example; real public codes allowed at runtime)
fields.dataClassification: one of canonicalEnums.dataClassification; a public link/code is PUBLIC_OBSERVED

fields.redirectHopUrl: array of per-hop URLs as observed, e.g. [https://go.example.invalid/1, https://exchange.example.invalid/ref]
fields.redirectHopHttpStatus: array of per-hop HTTP status integers, e.g. [302, 200]
fields.finalDestinationUrl: final resolved URL as observed, e.g. https://exchange.example.invalid/register
fields.evidenceSnapshotId: EvidenceSnapshot id in the evidence store
fields.screenshotEvidenceId: screenshot object id in the evidence store

invariants: redirect chains are captured anonymously; no cookies/credentials/tokens are stored (those are SENSITIVE_SECRET)

fields.offerHeadline: the visible offer headline as observed, e.g. 'up to <observed maximum> reward' (fake example text)
fields.advertisedMaximumValue: numeric maximum as advertised (observed at L2), example fake value 100
fields.termsUrl: public terms URL as observed, e.g. https://exchange.example.invalid/terms
fields.redactionPolicy: one of [NONE, REDACT_QUERY_TOKENS] applied before storage to strip any accidental session token from a URL

invariants: headline language uses 'up to' style, never a guaranteed reward
advertisedMaximumValue is an OBSERVED public figure, not a promise
example values are fake and use example.invalid

fields.termType: one of [GEO_ELIGIBILITY, NEW_USER_ELIGIBILITY, KYC_REQUIRED, DEPOSIT_CONDITIONS, TRADING_CONDITIONS, TIME_WINDOW]
fields.timeWindow: observed public text, e.g. within 30 days of registration

catalog.definition: The complete redirect chain resolves anonymously to a final destination.
The visible public offer is captured with snapshot and hash.
Public terms and GEO/new-user eligibility are captured and supported.
Reward confirmed via a real account. Separate owner authorization only; no automation, proxy, fake identity or prohibited financial actions.

fields.outcome: one of [CONFIRMED, CHANGED, BROKEN, GEO_BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE]

offerStatusToCtaMapping.note: CTA may be enabled ONLY when existing owner route/code/CTA approvals are valid (owner-gated).
cautious 'check conditions' presentation; enable is owner-gated.
CTA disabled or shown in a review state.
CTA suppressed or corrected only after owner review.

ctaAuthorityRule: Fail-safe suppression (GEO_SUPPRESSED, FAILSAFE_SUPPRESSED, UNDER_REVIEW) MAY be applied automatically. Any ENABLE/re-enable, affiliate route change or referral-code change is RED / owner-gated.

legacyMappings.note: Prior V1 values are retained here only as migration mappings and are not current values.
